tree: How do I calculate a percentage discount?
Multiply the original subtotal by the discount rate to find the discount amount, then subtract it from the original subtotal. For example, 25% off $100 saves $25 and leaves $75 before tax.

tree.style: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; padding:14px 0; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#202722

tree: Each percentage is applied to the amount remaining after the previous percentage discount. For example, 20% off followed by 10% off equals a 28% effective discount, not 30%.

tree.style: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; padding:14px 0; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#202722

tree: Can I apply a fixed amount coupon after a percentage discount?
Yes. Turn on “Also apply a fixed coupon”. The calculator applies the percentage steps first, then subtracts the fixed amount per order or per unit, depending on the scope you select.

tree.style: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; padding:14px 0; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#202722

tree: Can I calculate discounts for multiple items?
Yes. Enter the unit price and quantity. The calculator starts with unit price multiplied by quantity, then applies the selected discounts, and also shows the rounded price per unit.

tree.style: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; padding:14px 0; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#202722

tree: Is sales tax calculated before or after the discount?

You choose. “Add tax after discounts” calculates tax on the discounted subtotal. “Price includes tax” treats the discounted amount as tax-inclusive and shows the tax it contains. Actual tax treatment varies by location, product and coupon terms, so check local requirements.

tree.style: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; padding:14px 0; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#202722

tree: Does changing currency convert the amount?
No. Currency selection changes the symbol, number formatting and decimal places only. It does not perform an exchange-rate conversion.

tree.style: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; padding:14px 0; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#202722

tree: Is the Noxtill Discount Calculator free?
Yes. It’s free to use with no usage limit, and you don’t need a Noxtill account.

tree.style: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; padding:14px 0; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#202722

tree: Does Noxtill store the prices or discount values I enter?

No. The calculation runs in your browser. The values you enter aren’t sent to Noxtill, added to the page address or saved in browser storage, and they’re cleared when you reset or leave the page. Copy, CSV and print all happen on your device.
